releases.summary: Fixes an update that finished but could never say so. The reload restarts the process writing the record, so the panel sat on “reload…” for ever and refused every later update. It now settles such a run from the version actually running, and always offers a way to clear one.

Write your own CSS — for the whole site, or for one page — and switch on Google Analytics with a measurement id. Saving a page now shows the change straight away: three caches were holding the old one, and there is a Clear cache button for when one still does.

Fixes updating: the update now finds your site’s process instead of assuming it is called “engine”, stops on a failed migration instead of rebuilding anyway, and adds npm run db:status. No database changes.

Your site can speak more than one language, advertise jobs and take applications. Fifty-five more typefaces, including Armenian. What visitors send is now deleted after a period rather than kept for ever.
Export a site's content — pages, posts, media and design — and import it into another site. No accounts and no visitor data travel with it.
Three more roles — manager, author and reviewer — alongside administrator and editor. Existing accounts are unchanged.
The first release: block builder, templates, sliders, forms, popups, email, security, backups, and a browser installer that writes its own configuration.
